Package de.eldoria.eldoutilities.debug

Class DebugReport

java.lang.Object
de.eldoria.eldoutilities.debug.DebugReport
public final class DebugReport extends Object
A debug report as Lyna takes it, in its second format: the plugin and the server, then the sections in the order they are shown: health checks, what the plugin adds about itself, the log, the exceptions with their counts, and the configuration files.

It is built in two steps. collect(Plugin) asks the server about itself and the plugin's DebugDataProviders, including their health checks, which belongs on the thread that owns that state; create(Snapshot, DebugSettings) then reads the log and the configuration files and filters everything, which may take a while and runs anywhere.
